summary: Tested APK release feature end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass covering /init validation (non-.apk 400, missing version 400, >300MB 400), chunked upload (4MB chunks), /complete with PK magic verification + size check, /superadmin/apk list, DELETE soft-delete, public /latest, public /download (bytes identical to source, Content-Disposition SuriRent-{version}.apk, downloads counter increments), and 403 for non-superadmin (demo@surirent.sr). Frontend: Landing page / shows hero-apk-download + footer-apk-download with text 'Download de Android-app' and 'v1.0.0 · 3 MB' (seeded). Superadmin login + navigation to /admin/saas_settings renders apk-releases-section. Uploaded fake 5 MB .apk starting with 'PK' bytes via apk-file-input + version/notes + apk-upload-btn: progress bar visible, release appeared in list with 'Actief' badge, apk-delete-{id} with confirm successfully removed it. Seeded v1.0.0 preserved as requested.
critical_code_review_comments: Chunks stored temporarily in MongoDB (db.apk_chunks) with full binary payload — fine for 300MB cap but Mongo document size limit is 16MB per chunk, which matches _APK_CHUNK_MAX=6MB (OK). Consider TTL index on apk_chunks/apk_uploads to clean up abandoned uploads.
apk_upload_complete validates PK magic (b'PK') which only checks ZIP header, not that it's a real Android APK (missing AndroidManifest.xml check). Acceptable for MVP but note in docs.
/api/public/apk/download has no rate limiting — could be abused. Downloads counter is incremented before stream completes; a failed/aborted download still counts.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Seeded v1.0.0 release preserved; any test releases created were cleaned up via DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: APK feature fully working. Backend chunked upload via raw octet-stream PUT, PK magic validation, public download streaming all verified. Frontend testids: apk-releases-section, apk-file-input, apk-version-input, apk-notes-input, apk-upload-btn, apk-upload-progress, apk-release-{id}, apk-delete-{id}, hero-apk-download, footer-apk-download. SaaS Settings route = /admin/saas_settings (URL-derived tab).
